name: @avatark/episode-semantic-generation
description: PLT-ADR-009 Amendment (G10D-5 Stage 1) / STK-WO-009: the Episode Semantic Generation boundary. Consumes only a governed CertifiedInterpretation plus a governed content-source input (human-originated only, today) and produces a non-authoritative EpisodeContentProposal -- never an EpisodeCandidate, never a CertifiedEpisode, never a NarrativeDefinition. Owns proposal construction, canonicalization, and content-origin provenance; does not own World truth, Interpretation certification, Episode authority, Episode certification, or runtime execution.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
